purpose_note: This page states what the current evidence suggests will keep happening if nothing changes. Every entry is a reasoned judgement, not a proven fact and not a measured probability. Confidence is described in plain terms and every entry states what specific new evidence would revise it. Nothing here is a prediction with a due date, and nothing here should be read as more certain than a person reading the underlying evidence themselves would conclude.

assessments.statement: Absent an external prompt (a direct question to Council, a GIPA request, or similar), Willawarrin's plant is likely to reach a confirmed commissioning date later than the 'early 2026' target already stated in the register (EV-0006/EV-0068) - which has now passed without a commissioning record appearing.
assessments.basis: Lattice Atlas LP-001: funding, construction, and commissioning have each been logged as later-than-previously-expected relative to the prior stage's own stated target, across three successive project milestones.
assessments.confidence_note: Based on a repeated pattern across multiple stages of the same project, not a single data point. Still a judgement about institutional behaviour, not a measured probability.
assessments.would_revise_this: A commissioning certificate, practical-completion notice, or explicit operational statement appearing in the evidence register at any point would resolve Q-0001 directly and make this assessment moot.

assessments.statement: Absent a specific, targeted request, Bellbrook's water treatment plant augmentation is likely to remain at the 'planning confirmed, delivery unconfirmed' stage it has held since 2020-21 (EV-0071).
assessments.basis: No evidence of tender, funding line, contractor, or construction start has been located for this specific project across the roughly five years since EV-0071, despite multiple search passes.
assessments.confidence_note: This is a single project observed over one gap period, not a repeated pattern - avoid over-generalising from one data point. It is closer to 'nothing found yet' than 'confirmed non-movement'.
assessments.would_revise_this: Any new register entry showing tender activity, a funding allocation, a contractor award, or construction commencement for a Bellbrook-specific plant.

assessments.statement: The missing 2019-2020 crisis-year water-quality report is unlikely to be located through further general web search.
assessments.basis: Multiple independent DFAPTI search passes have not located it, and the report series is independently documented as having unstable naming/URL conventions and at least one apparent publication gap (AR-005, AR-020).
assessments.confidence: Reasonably supported for the specific method (web search); no basis for confidence about other methods
assessments.confidence_note: Repeated negative search results narrow where the document probably isn't findable by search, but do not establish it doesn't exist - see the register's own Absence Capture discipline. A different method (a direct GIPA request to Council) has not been tried and isn't covered by this assessment.
assessments.would_revise_this: The document surfacing via any method, or Council confirming in writing that no such report was produced or retained.

assessments.statement: Without a manually-performed direct fetch (not an automated one), the 14 September 2024 election-date discrepancy (Q-0006) is unlikely to reach Accepted/Verified status through further automated collection passes alone.
assessments.basis: Three independent attempts to directly fetch a primary elections.nsw.gov.au page - across at least two separate collection passes plus this cycle's reconciliation - have all returned HTTP 403, an environment-level barrier rather than a missing document.
assessments.confidence_note: The barrier has been consistent and specific (same error, same domain, multiple independent attempts) rather than intermittent, which is why this is stated with higher confidence than TPA-001 through TPA-003.
assessments.would_revise_this: A human manually visiting and saving the NSW Electoral Commission page (or an archived copy, e.g. via the Wayback Machine) so it can be hashed and registered as Accepted.

not_claimed: No entry above is a prediction of what will happen by a specific date.
No entry above is a measured probability - the confidence labels are qualitative judgements about how well-supported the pattern is, not statistics.
None of these assessments authorise or compel any action by any institution. They describe what this investigation expects to keep finding if nothing changes, nothing more.
